en: Black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a street scene in an Italian town. People walk along a curved, relatively modern street bordered by multi‑story buildings with shops at ground level and apartments above. A few bicycles and pedestrians are visible; mountains rise in the background. The image has a white border with scalloped edges, and a caption is printed at the bottom.
